keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job title, skills or company to search for (Indeed's "What" field).

location.title: Location
location.description: City, state, ZIP code or "remote" (Indeed's "Where" field). Leave empty to search the whole country.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code that selects the Indeed site: us = www.indeed.com, uk = uk.indeed.com, ca = ca.indeed.com, br = br.indeed.com, and so on.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to save.

daysPosted.title: Posted within (days)
daysPosted.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. Indeed supports 1, 3, 7 and 14; other values are rounded up to the nearest supported value.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of pages open at the same time. Keep it low to avoid blocks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Indeed actively blocks scrapers. Apify Proxy is strongly recommended; residential proxies give the best success rate.
